thread:
sam: heads-up: multiple promotes for release 2026-03-22 failing with multipart finalize errors and lease conflicts since 12:05 UTC.

rachel: runners report: `finalize multipart: size mismatch` and deploy-bot shows 409/412 lease errors.

ops: quick triage: either pin to previous green or throttle writers on storage. change window in 2h, ops prefers pin if safe.

sre-oncall: mitigation we can apply now: lower max_writers and bump client backoff. patch: `kubectl -n infra patch cm storage-config -p '{"data":{"max_writers":"5","client_backoff_ms":"500"}}'` I'll watch metrics for 10m.

rachel: if we pin, we need release-note line + rollback checklist. release candidate that passed canary last night: build-2026-03-20-aa11.

release-manager: create RM-10212 to track storage-finalize failures and link to this release. proceed with manual pin if canaries OK.

sam: applying throttles now. will wait 5m and then run manual promote to build-2026-03-20-aa11 if errors subside. please ack.

deploy-bot: manual promote started by sam at 1746004450; step1 snapshot -> success; step2 upload -> pending.

sre-oncall: metrics show lease_conflicts down 90% after throttle. green to promote.

rachel: running promote + will monitor canaries. will abort if artifact verification fails.

deploy-bot: promote progress: snapshot ok, routing update ok, canary 2/2 healthy at 1746004555, finalize -> success at 1746004560.

sam: thanks team. pinned to last-green and promoted to keep change window. RM-10212 created for investigation. release-manager will update release-notes and support.
